communication.transport: local JSON inboxes plus bounded sequential dispatcher
communication.dispatch_scope: Coordinator CLI and MCP requests default to three; other direct CLI roles default to zero.

scheduler: Package advisory flock serializes heavy workers; a parent releases its model before dispatching children. Other apps are outside this lock.
isolation: Validated workspace paths and browser host routing; argv commands run under the user OS account, not an OS sandbox.
stop_control: Turn/time limits, Ctrl-C/SIGTERM cleanup and owned process groups; measured acceptance is in lifecycle-acceptance.json.

qualification.regression: source tests pass; live extracted-runtime, clean-install, and publication gates remain open
